summary: Implementation in tests/test_loop/duplicate_transactions.py uses the linear count-then-filter approach specified by the design (single pass to build key_counts, second pass to emit IDs whose key count > 1). The key shape (account_id, merchant, amount_cents) is preserved. A focused regression test (test_large_input_uses_linear_number_of_duplicate_key_calls) is present and budgets _duplicate_key calls to <= 3n. However, the reviewer was unable to execute pytest in this environment (each python -m pytest invocation was denied by the permission layer), so no acceptance criterion requiring automated test evidence can be marked passed. Per review policy this must be reported as BLOCKED rather than APPROVED.

Static review: _duplicate_key returns (account_id, merchant, amount_cents) tuple unchanged; AC-5 satisfied by inspection.
Static review: regression test exists and enforces a linear (<= 3n) call budget on _duplicate_key via monkeypatch, which is the contract AC-3 asks for.
